title: Grammar
description: JSON Schema for a grammar — specializes production-system (Chomsky 1959) by adding optional resolution-conformance rules attached to terminal classes. Inherits the four-tuple structure (variables, terminals, productions, start) from production-system via allOf. The unevaluatedProperties: false on this leaf schema locks the surface to exactly production-system's fields plus resolution-rules.

resolution-rules.description: Optional resolution-rule list: for each terminal class, the predicate a parsed component must satisfy beyond its lexical shape (e.g., a parsed gerund must resolve to an existing transformer record on the filesystem).

terminal.description: The terminal class to which the rule applies.

predicate.description: A predicate name that a parsed component classified under this terminal must satisfy.
